$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：天機巨門坐卯酉，《深造講義》p.191。

basis.quote: 须分别其为稳重，抑或为浮薄

rules.text: 穩重的一面較重：古人說「機巨同臨，位至三公」，指的就是這一類。
rules.en: The steady side is stronger: when the ancients said 'Ji and Ju together rise to the highest office', this is the kind they meant.

source.quote: 是指本质稳重的[机巨]而言

rules.text: 浮薄的一面較重：古人說「天機巨門為破蕩」，指的就是這一類。
rules.en: The flighty side is stronger: when the ancients said 'Tian Ji with Ju Men breaks and scatters', this is the kind they meant.

source.quote: 则是指浮薄的『机巨』而言

rules.text: 你的巨門化祿，這組星最吉利。
rules.en: Your Ju Men is transformed by Lu, the most favourable case for these stars.

rules.text: 你的天機化忌，增加浮蕩。
rules.en: Your Tian Ji is transformed by Ji, adding restlessness.

source.quote: 若天机化忌，则增加浮荡

rules.text: 你的巨門化忌，容易變得輕薄，是這組星最不宜的。
rules.en: Your Ju Men is transformed by Ji, which can make you flippant, the least suitable case for these stars.

rules.text: 你的機巨與鈴星同宮，最易破壞穩重。
rules.en: Your Ji–Ju shares the palace with Ling Xing, which most easily undermines steadiness.

rules.text: 你的機巨與火星同宮，容易破壞穩重。
rules.en: Your Ji–Ju shares the palace with Huo Xing, which can undermine steadiness.

source.quote: 火铃二垣容易破坏[机巨]的稳重

rules.text: 你的機巨在酉，會照的太陽得地，浮薄之性減少，比在卯宮有利。
rules.en: Your Ji–Ju sits in You, where the Sun it meets has ground, lessening flightiness: better than in Mao.

source.quote: 故[机巨]以酉宫数为有利

rules.text: 你屬穩重的一型，天同所在的那一步運或那一年，往往就是你興家立業的時候，要把握。
rules.en: You are the steady kind: the phase or year that runs through Tian Tong is often when you build your household and career, so seize it.

source.quote: 往往在天同躔度的流年或大运兴家立业

rules.text: 貪狼所在的那一步運，往往是你人生大改變的時期；浮動的一型動盪幅度更大，要有貪狼化祿或化權，變化才不會帶來壞影響。
rules.en: The phase that runs through Tan Lang is often a time of major change for you, and the restless kind swings wider; only with Tan Lang in Abundance or Authority does the change pass without harm.

source.quote: 其动荡幅度亦往往更大

rules.text: 你的天機巨門坐卯，最忌行到酉宮那一步運。
rules.en: Your Tian Ji–Ju Men sits in Mao, and the phase that runs through You is the one it fears most.

source.quote: 原坐卯宫者不宜行酉限

rules.text: 你的天機巨門坐酉，最忌行到卯宮那一步運。
rules.en: Your Tian Ji–Ju Men sits in You, and the phase that runs through Mao is the one it fears most.
